title: Sources lifecycle: status = to-do list, csnotes sources = inventory, course dormancy
description:
Design agreed 2026-10-21. Problem: status lists 35 'unprocessed' sources, but 'unprocessed' only means 'never the subject of process --source'. 15 of the 35 are already credited in notes. Sources are library material, not inbox items. Decisions:
- status becomes a to-do list (pending sessions, open flags) plus ONE summary line for sources pointing at the new command. No per-source listing.
- New 'csnotes sources' command for the inventory (named 'sources' to match --source; 'library' stays free for future resources/self-study work).
- No kind-based inbox/library split (option B rejected): AI-conversation relevance varies too much to decide by kind.
- 'Used' = credited in some note's contributing_sources (not 'was in a workspace', which inflates the count because untagged sources go into every workspace).
- Dormancy (C): a source tagged only with inactive courses is hidden from new workspaces and the status count. Derived from active_courses at query time, never stored, so re-activating a course revives its sources.
Subissues hold the implementation.
